message: The other day, I accidentally set off the smoke alarm while cooking dinner—turns out, my idea of "perfectly seared" was a little too smoky! 😅 Instead of panicking, my kids and I turned it into a fun fire drill, practicing our escape plan together. We even pretended we were superheroes rushing to save the day! It's funny how a little chaos can turn into a cozy family moment. Have you ever made a safety lesson into a family adventure?
